verse.verse_1: WHEN THE WORLD is shaken up by its cataclysm,
verse.verse_2: And the earth throws out its burdens,
verse.verse_3: And man enquires: "What has come over it?"
verse.verse_4: That day it will narrate its annals,
verse.verse_5: For your Lord will have commanded it.
verse.verse_6: That day people will proceed separately to be shown their deeds.
verse.verse_7: Whosoever has done even an atom's weight of good will behold it;
verse.verse_8: And whosoever has done even an atom's weight of evil will behold that.
